name: India DPDP Rules 2025

phased_commencement.note: Rule 1(2)–(4): Rules 1, 2, 17–21 on Gazette publication; Rule 4 one year after; Rules 3, 5–16, 22 and 23 eighteen months after. Dates are computed from 13 November 2025 publication.

description: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 — operational SecuraIQ control pack. Each control carries effective_from so SecuraIQ can evaluate readiness against the applicable commencement phase rather than treating every rule as immediately enforceable.
legal_disclaimer: SecuraIQ produces an evidence-backed readiness assessment for authorised labs and customer-owned systems — not a determination that an organisation is legally 'DPDP compliant'. Significant Data Fiduciary (SDF) status and other applicability questions require human/legal review against the Act, Rules, and the organisation's circumstances. Official source of truth: MeitY / Gazette of India.

resources.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 (MeitY / Gazette)
resources.note: G.S.R. 846(E), 13 November 2025. Confirm corrigenda before relying on any rule text.

controls.title: Short title and commencement tracking
controls.description: Track which Rules are in force for the organisation's assessment date.

controls.title: Definitions applied consistently
controls.description: Use Act/Rules definitions consistently in policies, notices, and records.

controls.title: Notice clear, standalone, and itemised
controls.description: Notices must be independently understandable; include itemised personal data and specified purposes; provide links/means for withdrawal, rights, and Board complaints.

controls.title: Consent Manager registration path
controls.description: If using a Consent Manager, ensure Board registration and First Schedule obligations are met.

controls.title: State subsidy/benefit processing controls
controls.description: Where processing for State subsidy/benefit/service/certificate/licence/permit, follow Rule 5 standards.

controls.title: Reasonable security safeguards
controls.description: Minimum safeguards include securing data (encryption/obfuscation/masking/tokens), access controls, visibility/logs for unauthorised access detection, continuity backups, processor contractual safeguards, and organisational measures.

controls.title: Personal data secured at rest/in transit
controls.description: Demonstrate securing of personal data through encryption, obfuscation, masking, or virtual tokens.

controls.title: Access control and authentication for personal data
controls.description: Appropriate access controls covering processing by the Fiduciary and its Processors.

controls.title: Logging and monitoring of personal data access
controls.description: Maintain visibility via logs/monitoring/review to detect, investigate, and remediate unauthorised access.

controls.title: Backup and continuity for personal data systems
controls.description: Ensure continuity of processing / resilience including backups for systems processing personal data.

controls.title: Intimation of personal data breach
controls.description: On awareness of a personal data breach: intimate affected Data Principals without delay; intimate the Board without delay and with detailed follow-up within 72 hours (or longer period allowed).

controls.title: Time periods for specified purpose erasure
controls.description: Erase personal data when Third Schedule time periods / purpose-completion rules require, unless law requires retention.

controls.title: Processing/traffic log retention minimum
controls.description: Retain processing/traffic/other logs for at least one year (Seventh Schedule purposes) then erase unless law requires otherwise.

controls.title: Contact information of Data Protection Officer / responsible contact
controls.description: Publish contact details of DPO (if any) or other person able to answer Data Principal questions.

controls.title: Verifiable consent for processing children's data
controls.description: Adopt technical/organisational measures for verifiable parental consent and due diligence that the parent is an adult identifiable if required.

controls.title: Verifiable consent for persons with disability (guardian)
controls.description: When obtaining guardian consent for a person with disability, verify guardian appointment under applicable law.

controls.title: Exemptions relating to processing of children's data
controls.description: If relying on Second Schedule exemptions, document class of Fiduciary and restricted purposes.

controls.title: Additional obligations of Significant Data Fiduciary
controls.description: SDF (only if applicable): annual DPIA + audit; algorithmic due diligence; process government-specified data without transfer outside India when required.

controls.title: Rights of Data Principals — request mechanism
controls.description: Publish means and particulars for Data Principals to exercise rights; identify and respond to requests.

controls.title: Consent Manager obligations (platform)
controls.description: Consent Managers must enable give/manage/review/withdraw consent and retain required records (at least seven years unless otherwise agreed/required).

controls.title: Processing for research/archiving/statistics standards
controls.description: Where processing for research/archiving/statistical purposes under applicable standards, document necessity and safeguards.

controls.title: Calling of information by Central Government
controls.description: Have a process to respond to lawful Central Government information calls under the Rules.

controls.title: Techno-legal measures / Board proceedings digitisation
controls.description: Track techno-legal measures expectations as Board digitisation provisions commence.

controls.title: Personal data inventory and classification
controls.description: Maintain an inventory of personal data elements, systems, purposes, and classifications — prerequisite for notice, retention, and rights.

controls.title: Processor inventory and contractual safeguards
controls.description: Inventory Data Processors/sub-processors; ensure contracts include purpose, data categories, and reasonable security safeguards.
